_comment: Single source of truth for feature flags. Consumed by the Python backend (dbcore/feature_flags.py) and the Qwik frontend (apps/web). `default` is the fail-safe used when PostHog is unreachable or the flag is undefined there; self-host (no POSTHOG_API_KEY) ignores defaults and enables everything. Keys must match the PostHog feature flag keys exactly.

signups.description: New account registration. Login is NEVER gated.

link-creation.description: Creating new short links. Existing links always redirect.

custom-slugs.description: Vanity slugs on link creation (paid feature).

billing.description: Paywall, checkout and /billing/offerings. The RevenueCat webhook is NEVER gated.
